findings.title: Make scheduler and total-node admission controls explicit before attributing a capacity difference to topology.
evidence: profiles/mistral-medium-3.5.fp8.vllm.baseline.json sets --max-num-batched-tokens 16384; TP2 probe omits that flag.
Per-group active/batch limits can multiply when topology introduces replicas even on the same eight GPUs and offered trace.
findings.risk: A scheduler/admission change can be counted as a tensor-parallelism effect.
findings.resolution: Author now fixes total-node admission/concurrency first, logs per-group batching/scheduler limits, declares budget policy and separates capacity tuning; Mistral explicitly identifies 16384 versus omitted default. Unmatched budgets are labelled complete-configuration comparisons.
findings.verified: Read revised Q27-06, G31-05, M35-03 and following 16384 note; diff whitespace check passed.

limits: No GPU, model execution, harness execution or serving verification; this review assesses documentation, profile controls and primary-source consistency.

Export current-versus-pin metadata for all seven artifacts is supplied by the same-task author receipt; independent HTTP capture was limited to base target and EAGLE immutable artifacts plus two benchmark documents.
Benchmark/evaluator/adapter/runtime qualification remains a prerequisite to actual results.
No additional live main polling after root requested a fixed dated cutoff.

checks.details: Base current/pin identity checks from same-task author receipt reviewed; independently re-fetched eight immutable base/EAGLE cards/configuration files with hashes matching author captures. Publication metrics are clearly separate from proposed local evidence.

Exact publisher draft revision is named; native metadata is recognized; loader/build, 65536 draft example, initial 32768 target cap, extra memory and image-path qualification are distinct gates. No existing profile promoted.

IFBench strict/loose final-answer policy, OmniDocBench v1.5 component/composite distinction, fixed LCB releases/attempts, pinned RULER v1 NeMo dependency and labelled MMMU-Pro settings are explicit. Linked shared guide carries LCB full-loader and BFCL partial-coverage caveats.

32768 total-token and 32-active initial caps, parser omissions, Qwen KV auto versus SGLang bfloat16, qualification-only SGLang probes and separate topology/speculation/weight/cache axes are correctly described.
Serialized template/tools/images plus reserved generation must fit initial launch caps; 128/1024 service output shapes cannot establish completed reasoning quality; larger caps require qualification.
No dense repository files edited by reviewer; only /tmp review receipt/captures written.

verdict: No open blocking or correctness findings; one low-priority control clarification was implemented and independently checked.
